items.title: 3 US Dividend Stocks Built For Higher Rates
items.summary: Hawkish signals from the Fed are rattling growth stories and highly leveraged businesses, yet they can also shine a spotlight on sturdier dividend payers that already lean on cash flow and balance-sheet strength. Investors who ignore this shift risk missing pockets of resilience as borrowing costs stay in focus.
